Vendored dependencies for native Java 1.21.11 support

azalea-protocol 0.15.1+mc1.21.11 (MIT):
- ClientboundSetObjective Add/Change number_format is Option<NumberFormat>.
  The upstream crate incorrectly required a NumberFormat. Live ZeusPvP sent
  a present optional fixed format, which upstream misread as styled NBT.
  Confirmed against Mojang's verified 1.21.11 server JAR/mappings:
  ClientboundSetObjectivePacket.numberFormat is java.util.Optional and the
  RegistryFriendlyByteBuf constructor reads the optional codec.
- Regression coverage in tests/java_play.rs and the patched packet module.

azalea-chat 0.15.1+mc1.21.11 (MIT):
- Preserve run_command and suggest_command from NBT click_event (including
  legacy clickEvent/value spelling). Upstream NBT Style discarded all clicks.
- No remote action executes merely on receipt. Native UI presents run-command
  buttons which require an explicit mouse click while chat is open.
- No browser/file/custom actions are executed.
- Regression coverage decodes an actual system-chat packet in java_play.rs.

Source: published crates.io packages, https://github.com/azalea-rs/azalea
Each vendored directory includes its MIT LICENSE.md.

azalea-client 0.15.1+mc1.21.11 (MIT):
- Exposes join_transfer to send handshake intention Transfer (3) instead of
  Login (2) when following a server-requested transfer. Native connection
  handling follows the packet directly, retaining account and server cookies.
  This replaces upstream's empty game transfer handler for this application.

- Custom click action (config and game) now writes/reads VarInt length-prefixed
  optional network NBT, bounded to 65536 bytes. Official 1.21.11 abx bytecode
  uses aam$20 length wrapper around aam$7 optional NBT. None is [1,0].
  Exact None/Some bytes and full consumption covered in java_play.rs.
- ConfigPacket events expose server notices to the native frontend. Server
  cookies survive reconfiguration and transfer. Reconfiguration resets entity
  ID, loaded-chunk/client-loaded and sent-Spawn markers to emit a fresh Spawn.
  Live ZeusPvP Practice arrival verified after these corrections.

- azalea-chat accepts 1.21.11 flattened player/sprite object components using
  official ObjectContents styled U+FFFC placeholder so entity/player-info
  packets are not discarded. Object sprite graphics/metadata fidelity is
  still incomplete. Observed object+sibling wire regression in java_play.rs.

azalea-physics: retained source/license for pinned 0.15.1+mc1.21.11. Flying air acceleration uses PlayerAbilities flying_speed and sprint multiplier; flying travel restores pre-travel vertical velocity multiplied by 0.6 and bypasses fluid travel. Based on local 1.21.11 mapped Player bytecode. Native toggle/vertical input and full mounted/spectator flight coverage remain unfinished.

azalea-physics flight input: typed per-entity vertical input applied before travel; flying suppresses ordinary ground/liquid jumping; guarded native toggle preserves a one-shot grounded takeoff through repeated commands and consumes it once during the physics schedule. Physics integration fixture verifies two ticks and existing suite remains passing. Full altered-attribute/riding/spectator/fluid fidelity is unverified.

azalea-entity: pinned0.15.1+mc1.21.11 source and MIT notice retained. Dimension updates now respond to Small/ArmorStandMarker/InteractionWidth/InteractionHeight metadata and calculate half-size/zero-marker/custom interaction dimensions. Small armorstand eye height0.9875 follows verified1.21.11 client static dimensions. Dynamic bounds flow into spatial picking and native snapshots. Attribute scaling and exact attachments remain outside verified scope.

azalea-inventory: pinned0.15.1+mc1.21.11 vendored locally from the existing Cargo registry archive; shared upstream MIT workspace notice retained as LICENSE.md. BannerPattern.pattern now uses actual Holder<data::BannerPattern,BannerPatternData> (0 inline asset_id/translation_key; reference protocolID+1) rather than raw VarInt. Based on local official1.21.11 BannerPattern.STREAM_CODEC/ByteBufCodecs holder bytecode; actual inline/reference wire and ContainerSetContent next-slot/cursor alignment regressions live in root tests/native_shield_components.rs. Global Cargo registry was not modified. Existing checksums use Holder's registry-aware representation.
